description: This Kotlin file defines the implementation of the SearchContentsRepository interface, specifically the DefaultSearchContentsRepository class. It handles populating full-text search (FTS) data and executing search queries over news resources and topics, returning a SearchResult with matching items.

classes.name: DefaultSearchContentsRepository
classes.description: An implementation of SearchContentsRepository that provides methods to populate FTS data and perform search operations over news resources and topics.

methods.name: populateFtsData
methods.description: Populates the FTS tables for news resources and topics by fetching data from DAOs and inserting their FTS representations.

methods.name: searchContents
methods.description: Performs a search with the given query string, returning a flow of SearchResult containing matching topics and news resources.

methods.name: getSearchContentsCount
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting the total count of searchables (news resources + topics).
